description:
## Goal

`fz2 run|interp tools/distill-telemetry.exs trace.jsonl` and the built executable produce exactly the output `elixir tools/distill-telemetry.exs trace.jsonl` produces. The script's surface syntax does not change; fz gains the minimal Elixir surface, runtime and library it lacks. fz moves toward Elixir surface syntax.

## Signal

tests/distill_telemetry_test.rs runs the script under elixir over tests/distill_telemetry/main_returns_one.jsonl and compares two sections. The final ticket runs it under fz2 on all three paths and compares the whole output.

## Gaps found (probed with target/release/fz2 at 6ac603ac5, 2026-10-17)

- Enum over a JSON-decoded value fails: `Enum.count(Json.decode!("[1]"))` -> artifact/incomplete-semantic-plan, Enumerable.count/1 has no implementation.
- `& &1.inclusive` -> parse/expected-token (only local, remote, operator capture refs). `&(&1.inclusive)` works.
- `:erlang.abs(-3)` compiles as field access and fails at runtime: StructField: subject is not a map or Struct.
- Top-level expression after defmodule -> parse error at item position.
- fz2 rejects args after the source path (src/compiler2/cli.rs:589-599); AOT C main ignores argc/argv (src/ir_codegen/backend.rs:323-331); main's return value is discarded on every path.
- No IO, System, OptionParser, Stream, MapSet, Tuple, Collectable modules; no for comprehensions; no elem/length/map_size/is_integer/is_binary/inspect.

## Already works

String-keyed nested map patterns with literal lists, multi-clause 2-arg fn, 1_000_000, atom-key field access on maps, &(&1.x), map update syntax, with, Enum.group_by/frequencies_by/split_with/sort_by/zip/with_index, Map.get/3, Keyword.get/3.

## Working gate (2026-11-07)

Running the script is the gate and the thread we pull. After every landing: run `fz2 interp|run|build tools/distill-telemetry.exs tests/distill_telemetry/main_returns_one.jsonl` and diff each path against `elixir`. The first divergence is the next ticket; each fix is built properly, in its own ticket, but the order comes from the script, not from reading ahead in it. The children of fz-sc8.19 are the known inventory, not the order.

Frontier at 0163a8805: all three paths refuse the script at tools/distill-telemetry.exs:13:25, `unresolved direct runtime callee OptionParser.parse/2` (fz-sc8.16, behind the fz-sc8.72 -> .61 -> .63/.64 -> .62 -> .57 chain). elixir prints 112 lines.
title: tools/distill-telemetry.exs runs unchanged under fz2
